Company
As a Flex company, JetCool is scaling its industry‑leading liquid cooling technology
worldwide. By integrating into Flex’s extensive manufacturing ecosystem, JetCool
can design, build, and deliver complete liquid‑cooled rack solutions in‑house—while
seamlessly aligning with Flex’s power offerings to support full‑rack deployments.
This integration brings together
JetCool’s single‑phase,
direct‑to‑chip technology
with Flex’s unmatched global
production capabilities, deep
IT and power‑infrastructure
expertise, and shared
commitment to innovation.
